per_color_results.note: If completed=True, final_unique_triples_count is the exact MUS unique triple count (per deletion-based MUS definition). If completed=False, the value is an UPPER bound (we stopped shrinking with budget left to try) on what a full MUS pass would give — i.e. the true MUS has <= final_unique_triples_count unique triples but a longer run could shrink the bound further.
